audit.whatIsWrong: The content level chart gave levels 1-3 to Skill/Kayle/Kayle while every one of its own whys[0..2] says Gnar dominates a short-ranged melee Kayle. The full layer matched the wrong chart. Separately diff is HARD but diffRating is 4/10 and report[14] calls it a favoured matchup, on a 47.29% win rate.
audit.why: Kayle is the weakest early laner in the game and Gnar has ranged Mini autos; the packet chart agrees (Gnar/Gnar/Gnar/Skill/Kayle/Kayle/Kayle). The lane is early-favoured but loses overall, which is why 47.29% and HARD are both right and 4/10 'favoured' is not.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 flipped to Gnar in both layers with ratings raised; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 left Skill (matches packet, and whys[3]/[4] are genuinely two-sided); First item and 2+ items left with Kayle. diffRating moved to 6/10 and the 'Favoured matchup' line corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was called 'a long cooldown' four times without ever giving the number, and the packet flags that no Kayle ability is named anywhere.
audit.why: 160/120/80 is the whole reason the level-6 all-in exists — at rank 1 a baited R is off for 160 seconds, which is several waves, not a vague 'long'.
audit.corrected: 160s at rank 1 written into whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid; Radiant Blast and Celestial Blessing named in early; Starfire Spellblade named in mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two live interactions were absent from both layers: Celestial Blessing's heal and Starfire Spellblade's auto-attack reset. Radiant Blast's resistance shred and 900 range were never mentioned either.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing heals on a flat 15s cooldown and undoes Gnar's chip trades, which is what makes Executioner's a lane item rather than a late buy. Starfire Spellblade is an auto reset, so Kayle's burst starts on an auto wind-up with no spell animation to react to. Radiant Blast outranges everything Gnar has except the 1100-range Boomerang and cuts his resistances before her follow-up.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing and Radiant Blast added to early; the Starfire Spellblade wind-up tell added to mid.
sources: enemyKit Celestial Blessing cd 15 / Starfire Spellblade autoReset / Radiant Blast range 900

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.
edits.after: Unfavoured scaling lane — difficulty 6/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Divine Judgment and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. You own levels 1-5; the lane is decided by how much of that lead you bank before she scales.

edits.before: At 6 Kayle gets range and R, but its long cooldown means a full-Rage Mega Wallop into GNAR! wall-combo can still kill her before R resets.
edits.after: At 6 Kayle gets range and R, but Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 — a full-Rage Mega Wallop into GNAR! wall-combo kills her before it resets.

edits.before: Kayle gains range and her invulnerable R at 6, but it's a long cooldown: if your Rage is full, all-in NOW with Mega — Wallop stun into GNAR! wall-combo can kill her before R comes back up.
edits.after: Kayle gains range and her invulnerable R at 6, but rank-1 Divine Judgment is a 160-second cooldown: if your Rage is full, all-in NOW — Wallop stun into GNAR! wall-combo kills her long before it returns.

edits.before: Kayle is short-ranged and weak levels 1-5, so this is your free real estate — last-hit from Mini range and throw Boomerang on cooldown, catching it on the return for the partial refund. At level 2 your third consecutive Hyper hit plus a Boomerang is a chunky trade she can't answer: shove her in and deny CS so she falls behind her own scaling clock toward 6. Don't burn Hop chasing kills she can Flash; just stack the lead and keep her starved under tower.
edits.after: Kayle is short-ranged and weak levels 1-5, so this is your free real estate — last-hit from Mini range and throw Boomerang on cooldown, catching it on the return for the partial refund. At level 2 your third consecutive Hyper hit plus a Boomerang is a chunky trade she can't answer: shove her in and deny CS toward 6. Radiant Blast slows and shreds your resistances from 900 range, so step up after it whiffs, and buy Executioner's early — Celestial Blessing heals her every 15s and quietly undoes your chip.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are form RNG — if Rage is full, look to commit a Mega Wallop stun and trade hard while she's still short-ranged. At 6 Kayle gains range AND her invulnerable R, but that R is on a long cooldown: if your Rage is up, all-in immediately — walk her into a wall and GNAR! her after a Wallop for a kill before R resets. If you're stuck in Mini with Rage down, she simply farms safely behind her new range and you concede the window. Force the all-in only when Mega is guaranteed; never flip to fragile Mini mid-fight.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are form RNG — if Rage is full, commit a Mega Wallop stun and trade hard while she's still short-ranged. At 6 Kayle gains range AND her invulnerable R, but Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1: if your Rage is up, all-in immediately — walk her into a wall and GNAR! her after a Wallop, and a baited R is gone for the next two waves. Her burst tell is the Starfire Spellblade auto wind-up, not a spell cast, so back off on the wind-up. If you're stuck in Mini with Rage down, she farms safely behind her new range and you concede the window.

edits.before: Boomerang Kayle's last-hits, AA-hop out of his reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON his engage window.
edits.after: Boomerang Kayle's last-hits, AA-hop out of her reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON her Starfire auto wind-up.
